name: Office window
description: Big round-cornered white frame with a chunky cross mullion, deep sill ledge and one glass pane
mount: wall opening: origin at the bottom centre of a 2.2 x 1.17 m opening (the 0.95 m sill line), centred in the 0.3 m wall. Place at wallPoint(side, mid, 0.95); scale X for other widths.
